entity_id.description: The id of the entity in PostHog. For a kind whose key is a name, such as an event name or a context page path, that name finds it too.

kind.description: The definition kind of the entity. One of `flag`, `event`, `property_group`, `model`, `endpoint`, `metric`, `context_page`, `insight`, `dashboard`, `alert`, `destination`, `cohort`, `action`, `source`, `check`, `experiment` or `survey`.
